name: Lost Friends
source:
"You mustn't look into the face of a Nameless child, as the eyes of a sinner will stagnate your heart—"

For Kirio, a boy living in the solitary valley village of Uruku, there was someone he wanted forgiveness from more than anything.
That person was Hakamori: a boy who, despite being born in the same village, was deprived of his name and exiled as a sinner.

Seeking his forgiveness, Kirio spent 5 years visiting Hakamori--however, one day, upon meeting a creature calling itself Jack, an unexpected turn in events ultimately occurs...
translation:
“不要注视无名之子的脸，因为罪人的双眼会让你的心停滞——”

对生活在孤立山谷村庄乌鲁库的少年桐生而言，他最想得到某个人的原谅。

那个人是袴森：虽出生于同一村庄，却被剥夺姓名、以罪人身份流放的少年。

为了求得原谅，桐生拜访袴森整整五年。然而某天，他遇见自称杰克的生物，事情意外地发生了转折……
